204.description: The request completed successfully; no response body is returned

401.description: Authentication is required or the supplied credentials are invalid

403.description: The realm is inactive for a non-superuser, or the caller is neither the session owner, a user with write:admin, nor a superuser

404.description: The session or its owning user does not exist, or the session does not belong to the specified realm

405.description: A non-superuser cannot access the session owner's realm
